missingLaunchRequirements: Exact executable runner and invocation capable of launching four fresh isolated contexts.
Exact reader model/version and reasoning configuration, identical across conditions.
Per-attempt token or monetary ceiling and one aggregate ceiling covering all four attempts, including tool/model overhead.
Metering mechanism that measures the selected ceiling and terminates work before exceeding it; a requested budget in the prompt is insufficient.
Executable 600-second wall-clock timeout and supervisor that preserves partial artifacts when terminating.
Verified isolation of context, output directories, artifact conditions, and neutral starter/evaluator inputs.
releaseCondition: Launch only after exact settings and enforcing runner are recorded and verified, with authorization matching that concrete bounded execution. Do not treat protocol preparation or read-only retrieval as reader-trial authorization.
